28622: Kou is a 22-year-old man who self-proclaims to be part of the 'elite.' He is the first son of the Ichinomiya family, which makes him the heir of the family company.
28623: A mysterious girl who lives in Arakawa. She is a self-claimed Venusian and later Kou's girlfriend. The origin of her name comes from the sweatsuit that she always wear that has the tag "Class 2-3" (Ni-no-san) on it.
30444: A 24 year old man with a star-shaped head. Therefore he is simply named 'Hoshi' by the village chief. Hoshi is an artist who often performs with his guitar near the riverbank. He is also a heavy chain smoker and considers Riku as his rival (mostly for Nino's love).
30628: Maria is a pink haired woman who runs a nearby farm where all the Arakawa residents get their dairy and produce from. Whilst having a beautiful appearance, she casually passes out incredibly harsh insults to other people and is a sadist.
30648: The village chief of the area around the Arakawa riverbend. He is a green kappa that lives in the pond nearby. Only he has the authority to approve every newcomer to the river bend area. Often feels sad because he is discriminated by humans because of his outer appearance.
30649: A strange 29 year old gun-wielding man wearing a nun uniform. He therefore is named 'Sister' by the village chief. He was born in England and apparently a former mercenary who served the army.
30650: Stella is a little blonde girl from an orphanage in England that Sister ran. Whilst initially thought to be small and cute, she is a powerful fighter and sometimes speaks in a threatening tone to show her superiority.
30798: A young red-haired girl who grows vegetables for the village. She believes she is a ninja, though in reality she is the vision of a klutzy girl and is literally dangerously clumsy, often turning what should be a simple accident into a massive disaster.
30799: A cordial, middle-aged man who is obsessed with always stepping on a white line. The reason thus he always walks around pushing a line painter so that he always has something white to walk on.
30804: The older one of the Tetsujin brothers. According to him he was a guinea-pig in laboratory which he escaped with his twin brother.
30805: The younger one of the Tetsujin brothers. According to him he was a guinea-pig in laboratory which he escaped with his twin brother.
30806: Riku's father and director of the Ichinomiya company.
30807: Kou's secretary. After his wife left him, Takai became Kou's secretary in one of his companies. He became inspired by Kou and his words and becomes quite fond of him.
30808: Employee at Riku's company "GOES". Cool and beautiful woman.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
